title: The Southern Book Club's Guide to Slaying Vampires
author: Grady Hendrix
engineRationale: Horror fiction with suburban everywoman protagonists — no real historical figures to depict; Antidote's flat-vector rigged characters + kinetic typography capture the domesticity-vs-horror tension better than photoreal, and the genre's psychological dread suits expressive character rigs with symbolic motifs (blood, books, suburbia).
